title: Meet the four elements (Air, Fire, Water, Earth)
caption:
'You're so hot-headed.' 'You're so calm.' Turns out there are four options.

The four temperaments run from Hippocrates and Galen through Ibn Sina's Canon of Medicine, and Unani tradition still uses them: Air, Fire, Water and Earth. Each is a mix of warm or cool and moist or dry, and each is traditionally believed to colour your energy, pace and mood.

Traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.

Which one are you? Comment your element, then tag the friend who is obviously Fire.
